member.name: T:SysWeaver.JsConvertParams
member.summary: The command line options of JsConvert (all converter options plus the tool options)

member.name: F:SysWeaver.JsConvertParams.Suffix
member.summary: Text to add to the output file names (before the extension), ex: ".es5" writes "common.es5.js".

member.name: F:SysWeaver.JsConvertParams.Overwrite
member.summary: Allow the output to overwrite the source file (when there is no destination folder and no suffix).

member.name: F:SysWeaver.JsConvertParams.HelpersFile
member.summary: Write all helper functions (and polyfills) used by the converted files to this file instead of adding them to every file (sets Helpers to External). The file must be loaded (ex: with a script element) before the converted files. A name without a folder is created in the destination folder.

member.name: F:SysWeaver.JsConvertParams.Verbose
member.summary: Also show information messages (ex: built-ins that might be missing in the target).

member.name: F:SysWeaver.JsConvertParams.ShowTarget
member.summary: Show the target (EcmaScript version and browsers) and the features that will be transformed.

member.name: F:SysWeaver.JsConvertParams.Force
member.summary: Always write the output files (by default a file is only written if its content changed, so the time stamp of unchanged files is kept).

member.name: F:SysWeaver.JsConvertParams.Site
member.summary: Html files: clone the site, i.e. also process all scripts, style sheets (and other files, see SiteAssets) the pages use, including the files those reference (css @import / url(), script imports, workers and literal script / css paths). Scripts are converted, other files are copied, the paths relative to the site root are kept. Dependencies created dynamically with computed urls can't be found, iframes and links to other pages are not followed. If false, only the html file itself is converted.

member.name: F:SysWeaver.JsConvertParams.SiteRoot
member.summary: The root folder of the site(s): root relative urls ("/js/a.js") are resolved from here and the output keeps the paths relative to it. Default: root relative urls are searched in the folder of the page and its parents, the root is the common folder of all used files.

member.name: F:SysWeaver.JsConvertParams.SiteAssets
member.summary: Site mode: also copy the other files used by the pages and style sheets (images, fonts, icons, manifests ...), not only scripts and style sheets.

member.name: F:SysWeaver.JsConvertParams.SiteScanStrings
member.summary: Site mode: also follow string literals in scripts that are relative paths of existing .js / .mjs / .css files (ex: includeJs("lib.js")).

member.name: F:SysWeaver.JsConvertProgram.ExitConvertFailed
member.summary: Exit code: one or more files couldn't be converted (errors, or warnings with -WarningsAsErrors), the other files are converted.

member.name: M:SysWeaver.JsConvertProgram.WriteIfChanged(System.String,System.String,System.Boolean)
member.summary: Write a file if the content changed (or if forced)

member.name: F:SysWeaver.JsConvertProgram.SitePages
member.summary: The pages to clone, by destination root folder

member.name: M:SysWeaver.JsConvertProgram.Report(SysWeaver.IMessageHost,SysWeaver.JsConvertParams,System.String,System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable{SysWeaver.Converter.Js.JsDiagnostic})
member.summary: Write diagnostics in the MSBuild / Visual Studio format: file(line,col): warning: message

member.name: M:SysWeaver.JsConvertProgram.CloneSites(SysWeaver.IMessageHost,SysWeaver.JsConvertParams)
member.summary: Clone the sites of the html files (site mode)

member.name: F:SysWeaver.JsConvertProgram.LastMessageHost
member.summary: The message host of the files to folder tool (used for the site cloning after all files are processed)

member.name: M:SysWeaver.JsConvertProgram.Main(System.String[])
member.summary: Process exit codes, 0 = success, non-zero (1-255) = failure: 0 = success or help requested, 1 = an exception while processing, 2 = invalid command line, 3 = one or more files couldn't be converted.
